RECORDANDRETURNTO: Greenberg Traurig, LLP 200ParkAvenue,15thFloor New York,NY 1016 Atn: Nick Hockens TRANSFERINSTRUMENTANDNOTICEOFRESTRICTIONS TRANSFEROFDEVELOPMENTRIGHTSANDNOTICEOFRESTRICTIONS PURSUANT TOSECTION 81-74OF THEZONINGRESOLUTION OF THECITY OF NEW YORK NOTICE, made as of this 9" day of February, 2012, by and between SHUBERT Shubert Organization Inc., 234 West 44"h Street, New York, New York 10036 (the “Theater Owner"), and 237 WEST 54 OWNER, L.L.C., a Delaware limited liability company having an ("Purchaser"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, the Theater Owner is the owner of the Booth Theater,which is L. 15 15 of Block 1016 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, and by the street address 222 West N4 45th Street, New York, New York (the “Booth Theater"); and WHEREAS, Theater Owner operates the Booth Theater as a legitimate theater; and WHEREAS, Theater Owner is the owner of all the real property described in Exhibit A (the “Real Property"), which real property comprises a single zoning lot (the “Theater Zoning Lot"); and WHEREAS, the Real Property is located in the Theater Subdistrict, as such term is defined in Section 81-70 et seq.of the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York (the "Zoning Resolution"), and the Booth Theater is designated in Section 81-742 of the Zoning Resolution as a Listed Theater; and WHEREAS, the Theater Owner seeks to transfer certain Excess Floor Area Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) attributable to the Booth Theater from the Theater B.102 Zoning Lot to a parcel owned by Purchaser designated as Lot 12 of Block 1026 on the Tax Map L.12 of the City of New York, and by the street address 237 West 54"h Street, New York, New York (the “Receiving_Site"). The Receiving Site is more particularly described in Exhibit B hereto; hN and WHEREAS, the Receiving Site is located within the Theater Subdistrict, as such term is defined in Section 81-71 of the Zoning Resolution; and WHEREAS, such a transfer of development rights from a Listed Theater within the Theater Subdistrict to another site is governed by the provisions of Section 81-74 of the ZoningResolution; and 177244(Aeconodation) ROYALABSTRACT 1 500 Fifth Avenue, Suite 15401 NewYork,NY 10110 (212) 376-0900

WHEREAS,the transfer of the Excess Floor Area Development Rights attributable to the Booth Theater from the Theater Zoning Lot to theReceivingSite requires a certification by the City Planning Commission ("CPC") pursuant to Section 81-744 of the Zoning Resolution (the “Certification"); and WHEREAS, Purchaser desires to receive from Theater Owner, and Theater Owner desires to transfer to Purchaser, the Excess Floor Area Development Rights attributable to the BoothTheater. NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreements hereincontained,it isherebyagreed asfollows: “Floor Area Development Rights" shall mean the development rights, as determined in accordance with the Zoning Resolution, which are appurtenant to a zoning lot, to develop the zoning lot by erecting thereon a structure or structures with a total Floor Area (as hereinafter defined) determined (A) by multiplying the area of the zoning lot by the maximum allowable floor area ratio (as hereinafter defined) for structures in the zoning district or districts in which such zoning lot is located, (B) by the inclusion of any available “bonus” floor area, and (C) by the further inclusion of any use, bulk, density and other development rights permitted under the Zoning Resolution and which may be authorized to be developed'by the appropriate agency of The City of NewYork from time to time. “Excess Floor Area Development Rights” shall mean 24,100 square feet of Floor Booth Theater. “use” and “bulk" shall have the meanings set forth in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution. Theater Owner hereby conveys, assigns, transfers and sets over to Purchaser the Excess Floor Area Development Rights solely for the use and benefit, in perpetuity, of the Receiving Site. This conveyance is made subject to the trust fund provisions of Section 13 of the New York Lien Law. At the request and expense of Purchaser, Theater Owner covenants that it will execute or procure any further necessary assurances of its rights to make the within transfer. Notice is hereby given that this transfer (a) irrevocably restricts the available floor area appurtenant to the Theater Zoning Lot by reducing the Floor Area Development Rights appurtenant thereto by 24,100 square feet of floor area, and (b) benefits the Receiving Site by irrevocably increasing the Floor Area Development Rights appurtenant theretoby 24,100 square feet of floor area. Theater Owner covenants that at no time shall any building, buildings or improvements be situated on the Theater Zoning Lot which would have a floor area in excess of the floor area permitted thereon pursuant to the Zoning Resolution or any amendments thereof.
